Text: I find too many people just use /goal on its own, which is a powerful feature, but the combo move of using workflows and goal together really is something special, and I think it gets overlooked wayyyy too often.

Okay, hopefully this was helpful. If so, let me know, and of course if you have any specific questions about what I share here, feel free to ask questions below.

I write all these wacky threads by hand, without AI, as you can probably tell, and I don't do a lot of proofreading so apologies in advance for any typos or grammar errors.

Thanks for reading and Grok on 🤘
